rows.note: Use 姐夫 for the husband of one's older sister.

example.english: My brother-in-law is great at cooking.
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 ze2 fu1 hou2 sik1 zyu2 faan6

rows.note: Use 妹夫 for the husband of one's younger sister.

example.english: My brother-in-law is coming to help me move today.
example.jyutping: mui6 fu1 gam1 jat6 lai4 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

rows.note: Use 叔仔 for one's husband's younger brother.

example.traditional: 我老公個叔仔住喺加拿大。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lou5 gung1 go3 suk1 zai2 zyu6 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6

rows.note: Use 大伯 for one's husband's older brother.

example.english: My brother-in-law is picking up my son from school today.
example.traditional: 大伯今日幫手接個仔放學。
example.jyutping: daai6 baak3 gam1 jat6 bong1 sau2 zip3 go3 zai2 fong3 hok6
